# qrcode-esm

> QR code generator for Node.js and the browser. Pure ESM, written in TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies.

A modernized ESM TypeScript port of [qrcode](https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode) by Ryan Day.

- Package: `@quinnjr/qrcode-esm`
- Repository: https://github.com/quinnjr/qrcode-esm
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@quinnjr/qrcode-esm
- License: MIT
- Author: Joseph R. Quinn

## Install

```sh
npm install @quinnjr/qrcode-esm
```

## Key Features

- Pure ESM (ECMAScript Modules) — no CommonJS
- Written in TypeScript with full type declarations
- Zero runtime dependencies
- Separate optimized builds for Node.js and Browser
- Built-in PNG encoder (no native modules required)
- Supports QR versions 1–40
- Four error correction levels: L (~7%), M (~15%), Q (~25%), H (~30%)
- Automatic optimal encoding mode selection via Dijkstra's algorithm
- Custom colors with hex format (3, 4, 6, or 8 character hex strings)

## API

### Node.js Exports

- `create(text, options?)` — Returns `QRData` object (synchronous)
- `toString(text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<string>` (UTF-8 default)
- `toDataURL(text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<string>` (PNG data URL)
- `toBuffer(text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<Buffer>` (PNG buffer)
- `toFile(path, text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<void>` (format inferred from extension: .png, .svg, .txt)

### Browser Exports

- `create(text, options?)` — Returns `QRData` object (synchronous)
- `toString(text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<string>` (SVG default)
- `toDataURL(text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<string>` (canvas data URL)
- `toCanvas(text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<HTMLCanvasElement>` (creates new canvas)
- `toCanvas(canvas, text, options?)` — Returns `Promise<HTMLCanvasElement>` (draws on existing canvas)

### Input Type

`QRInput = string | (string | { data: string; mode?: Mode | string })[]`

Text string, or array of segments for mixed-mode encoding. Segment modes: `'numeric'`, `'alphanumeric'`, `'byte'`, `'kanji'`.

### Options (RendererOptions)

```typescript
interface RendererOptions {
  // QR generation
  version?: number;               // 1-40 (auto-detected if omitted)
  errorCorrectionLevel?: 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H'; // default: 'M'
  maskPattern?: number;           // 0-7 (auto-selected if omitted)
  toSJISFunc?: (kanji: string) => number;

  // Rendering
  type?: string;                  // 'png' | 'svg' | 'utf8' | 'terminal' | 'image/png'
  margin?: number;                // quiet zone in modules (default: 4)
  scale?: number;                 // pixels per module (default: 4)
  width?: number;                 // output width in pixels (overrides scale)
  small?: boolean;                // compact terminal rendering (default: false)
  inverse?: boolean;              // invert colors (default: false)
  color?: {
    dark?: string;                // hex color (default: '#000000ff')
    light?: string;               // hex color (default: '#ffffffff')
  };
  rendererOpts?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

### Key Types

```typescript
interface QRData {
  modules: BitMatrix;
  version: number;
  errorCorrectionLevel: ErrorCorrectionLevel;
  maskPattern: number;
  segments: Segment[];
}

interface ErrorCorrectionLevel { bit: number; }

type ErrorCorrectionLevelInput =
  | ErrorCorrectionLevel
  | 'L' | 'M' | 'Q' | 'H'
  | 'low' | 'medium' | 'quartile' | 'high';

interface Segment {
  mode: Mode;
  data: string | Uint8Array;
  getLength(): number;
  getBitsLength(): number;
}
```

## Usage Examples

### Node.js — Terminal output

```typescript
import { toString } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
const qr = await toString('https://example.com');
console.log(qr);
```

### Node.js — Save to PNG file

```typescript
import { toFile } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
await toFile('qr.png', 'https://example.com', {
  errorCorrectionLevel: 'H',
  width: 300,
  color: { dark: '#000000', light: '#ffffff' },
});
```

### Node.js — PNG buffer

```typescript
import { toBuffer } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
const buf = await toBuffer('https://example.com');
```

### Node.js — Data URL

```typescript
import { toDataURL } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
const url = await toDataURL('https://example.com');
```

### Browser — Canvas

```typescript
import { toCanvas } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
const canvas = await toCanvas('https://example.com');
document.body.appendChild(canvas);
```

### Browser — SVG string

```typescript
import { toString } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
const svg = await toString('https://example.com'); // SVG is default in browser
```

### Mixed-mode segments

```typescript
import { toString } from '@quinnjr/qrcode-esm';
const qr = await toString([
  { data: '1234567890', mode: 'numeric' },
  { data: 'ABCDEF', mode: 'alphanumeric' },
  { data: 'hello world', mode: 'byte' },
]);
```

## Error Correction Levels

| Level | Alias       | Recovery | Best for                                  |
|-------|-------------|----------|-------------------------------------------|
| L     | low         | ~7%      | Maximum density, clean display conditions |
| M     | medium      | ~15%     | Default. Balanced size and reliability    |
| Q     | quartile    | ~25%     | Partially obscured (stickers, posters)    |
| H     | high        | ~30%     | Logo overlays, maximum reliability        |

## Encoding Modes

| Mode          | Characters                              | Efficiency              |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| Numeric       | 0–9                                     | 3 digits per 10 bits    |
| Alphanumeric  | 0–9, A–Z, space, $ % * + - . / :       | 2 chars per 11 bits     |
| Byte          | Any UTF-8                               | 1 byte per 8 bits       |
| Kanji         | Shift JIS characters                    | 1 char per 13 bits      |

## Output Formats

| Format   | Node.js | Browser | Function(s)                            |
|----------|---------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| PNG      | Yes     | —       | toFile, toBuffer, toDataURL            |
| SVG      | Yes     | Yes     | toString, toFile, toBuffer, toDataURL  |
| UTF-8    | Yes     | Yes     | toString, toFile, toBuffer             |
| Terminal | Yes     | —       | toString (type: 'terminal')            |
| Canvas   | —       | Yes     | toCanvas, toDataURL                    |

## QR Version Sizes

Size formula: `modules = 17 + 4 × version`

Version 1: 21×21, Version 5: 37×37, Version 10: 57×57, Version 20: 97×97, Version 40: 177×177.

## Documentation

Full documentation: https://quinnjr.github.io/qrcode-esm/
